description: Tool to invite a user to a Calendly organization via email. Use when you need to send an organization invitation to a new user. Requires organization owner or admin privileges.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for inviting a user to a Calendly organization.

email.description: The email address of the user to invite to the organization. An invitation email will be automatically sent to this address.
email.title: Email

org_uuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the organization to invite the user to. This is extracted from the organization URI.
org_uuid.title: Org Uuid

inputSchema.title: CalendlyOrganizationInvitationRequest

name: organization_invitation

CalendlyOrganizationInvitationResponse.description: Response schema for creating an organization invitation.
CalendlyOrganizationInvitationResponse.title: CalendlyOrganizationInvitationResponse

OrganizationInvitationResource.description: The organization invitation resource object returned from the API.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the invitation was created (ISO 8601 format)
created_at.title: Created At

email.description: Email address of the person being invited to the organization
email.title: Email

last_sent_at.description: Timestamp when the invitation email was last sent to the invitee (ISO 8601 format)
last_sent_at.title: Last Sent At

organization.description: URI reference to the organization the user is being invited to
organization.title: Organization

status.description: Current status of the invitation. Possible values: 'pending', 'accepted', 'declined'
status.title: Status

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the invitation was last updated (ISO 8601 format)
updated_at.title: Updated At

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the organization invitation
uri.title: Uri

user.description: URI reference to the user resource. This field is null when the invitation status is pending, and populated with the user URI once the invitation is accepted.
user.title: User

OrganizationInvitationResource.title: OrganizationInvitationResource
